Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Entries.description: One entry per recorded file, sorted by Path.

Path.description: The project-relative path of the file.

XXH64.description: XXH64 (seed 0) of the bytes written: 16 lowercase hex digits.

Method.description: The automation method that wrote the file, "ui" for the windowed UI or "project.upgrade".

RequestId.description: The JSON-RPC id as sent; null for ui and cli writes.

Client.description: The client: session.hello's client name, "batch", "cli", "test" or "ui".

TranscriptLine.description: The request's 1-based line in Automation/BuildLog.jsonl, or null.
